content: Losartan is a medication that can be used either on its own or in combination with other drugs to manage high blood pressure. It belongs to a class of drugs known as angiotensin II receptor antagonists. This medication works by blocking the effects of certain chemicals in the body that cause blood vessels to constrict, thereby allowing blood to flow more easily. Important Warning: Do not take losartan if you are pregnant. If you become pregnant while taking this medication, contact your doctor immediately, as losartan can harm the developing fetus. How to Use This Medication: Losartan is available in tablet form and is taken orally, usually once or twice daily, with or without food. To ensure consistent use, take it at the same time every day. Follow the instructions on your prescription label carefully, and consult your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions. Take losartan exactly as prescribed. Do not take more or less than the recommended dose or take it more frequently than directed. While losartan helps control high blood pressure, it does not cure it. Continue taking the medication even if you feel well, and do not stop taking it without consulting your doctor. Other Uses for This Medication: Losartan is sometimes used to treat congestive heart failure. Discuss the potential risks of using this medication for your condition with your doctor. It may also be prescribed for other purposes; ask your doctor or pharmacist for more information. Special Precautions: Before taking losartan: Inform your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to losartan or any other medications. Provide a list of all prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking. Be sure to mention diuretics (water pills), indomethacin (Indocin), and potassium supplements. Your doctor may need to adjust your medication doses or monitor you closely for side effects. Notify your doctor if you have a history of heart failure, kidney disease, or liver disease. Inform your doctor if you are planning to become pregnant or are breastfeeding. Special Dietary Instructions: Consult your doctor before using salt substitutes that contain potassium. If your doctor has recommended a low-salt or low-sodium diet, follow these instructions carefully. What to Do If You Miss a Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed one. Side Effects: Minor Side Effects: Losartan may cause dizziness, a runny nose, or a sore throat. Inform your doctor if these symptoms are severe or persistent. Severe Side Effects: Although rare, serious side effects can occur. Contact your doctor immediately if you experience swelling of the face, throat, tongue, lips, eyes, hands, feet, ankles, or lower legs; hoarseness; difficulty breathing or swallowing; or fainting. If you experience any unusual problems while taking this medication, contact your doctor. Serious side effects can be reported to the FDA’s MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online or by phone. Storage Instructions: Store losartan in its original container, tightly closed, and out of reach of children. Keep it at room temperature, away from excessive heat and moisture (do not store it in the bathroom). Dispose of any expired or no longer needed medication properly. Consult your pharmacist for guidance on proper disposal. In Case of Emergency/Overdose: If an overdose occurs, contact your local poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. If the individual has collapsed or is not breathing, call 911 immediately. Symptoms of overdose may include dizziness, fainting, or a rapid or pounding heartbeat. Other Information: Keep all appointments with your doctor, as your blood pressure should be monitored regularly to assess your response to losartan. Do not share this medication with anyone else. If you have questions about refilling your prescription, consult your pharmacist.
